settings.textcontent:
Both creams combine effective sun protection with skincare benefits – however, they differ in formula and purpose.
The new Mattifying Cream SPF50 has an exceptionally light, non-overburdening consistency and was created for combination, oily, problematic or acne-prone skin – it helps reduce excessive sebum production.
The classic SPF50 Cream, on the other hand, is better suited for dry and normal skin – it has a richer, creamier formula that nourishes and protects the skin all day long.

settings.item_title_0: Why is it worth using mattifying cream SPF 50?
settings.item_title_1: What active ingredients does Mattifying Cream SPF50 contain?
settings.item_title_2: How to use Mattifying Cream SPF50 correctly?
settings.item_title_3: Is the Mattifying Cream SPF50 suitable for all skin types?
settings.item_title_4: Is SPF 50 cream suitable for all skin types?
settings.item_title_5: How often should I reapply Mattifying Cream SPF50?
settings.item_title_6: Can the SPF50 Mattifying Cream be used under makeup?
settings.item_title_7: Is the Mattifying Cream SPF50 safe for the environment?
settings.item_title_8: Can the Mattifying Cream SPF50 be used on other parts of the body?
settings.item_title_9: What is the difference between the Mattifying Cream SPF50 and the classic Routines Cream SPF50?

settings.textcontent: Using Mattifying Cream SPF50 provides multidimensional protection against harmful UV radiation, skin hydration and protection against damage caused by UV radiation.

This mattifying SPF50 cream contains organic UV filters, vitamin E, and bakuchiol, which have powerful antioxidant properties, as well as azeloglycine, which minimizes the appearance of pores, regulates sebum production, and has a brightening effect. The cream also contains panthenol, which provides intense hydration and regenerates sun-damaged skin.

To ensure proper protection, apply the cream to cleansed skin about 15-20 minutes before sun exposure. Use approximately 1-1.25 ml of product. Reapply the cream every 2-3 hours, and after swimming or toweling.
Yes, Mattifying Cream SPF50 is suitable for all skin types, and we especially recommend it for problematic skin with excess sebum production and imperfections.
Yes, SPF50 cream is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
The cream should be reapplied every 2-3 hours, as well as after each bath or towel drying.
Yes, the cream absorbs quickly, does not whiten the skin and leaves a matte finish, making it suitable for use under makeup.
Yes, the cream contains organic UV filters that are safe for the skin and the environment.
Yes, the cream can be used on other exposed parts of the body that require sun protection.

Organic UV filters
New-generation, broad-spectrum, photostable filters provide high protection against UVA and UVB radiation. They meet the highest safety and quality standards and are environmentally friendly.

Bakuchiol

A natural retinoid with powerful antioxidant properties. It has a rejuvenating effect by stimulating collagen and elastin production. It brightens the skin and evens out its tone. It soothes acne and regulates sebum production.

Azeloglicine

It effectively brightens the complexion, evens out skin tone, and reduces pigmentation spots. It regulates sebum production, prevents imperfections, and minimizes the appearance of pores. The glycine it contains improves skin elasticity and softness and supports its regeneration.

Vitamin E

It protects cells from oxidative stress. It improves skin elasticity and firmness, moisturizes it, and supports the regeneration of damage caused by UV radiation.
Every skin is unique. Each requires its own rituals, based on the effective combination of nature and science. Routines by Alkmie is a personalized care plan that you can tailor to your skin's needs.
UV protection is a key element of skincare - it protects the skin against premature aging, discoloration and diseases.

settings.headingtext: Get to know the full lineup

settings.textcontent: Vitamin B12 - soothes sensitive and irritated skin and accelerates its regeneration.
Lactoferrin - soothes, accelerates the process of reducing imperfections, supports the synthesis of hyaluronic acid and collagen.
Ceramilar - a ceramide-like complex, perfectly strengthens the skin's protective barrier, ensuring faster regeneration.
Natural SW - a complex of fermented ingredients: soy, rice, ginseng and adlay has a protective and soothing effect.
Every skin is unique. Each requires its own rituals, based on the effective combination of nature and science. Routines by Alkmie is a personalized care plan that you can tailor to your skin's needs.
Thanks to its soothing properties, this serum is the perfect complement to acid and retinoid treatments. Use it whenever your skin needs soothing.

settings.item_title_5: Can the serum with bioferments be used under makeup?
settings.item_title_6: Can serum with bioferments be used during pregnancy?

settings.textcontent: The serum contains botanical bioferments, vitamin B12, lactoferrin and a ceramide-like complex.
Using a serum with bioferments brings relief to sensitive and stressed skin, increases the synthesis of hyaluronic acid, helps reduce imperfections and protects the skin against excessive water loss.
Apply a small amount of serum to cleansed skin on the face, neck, and décolleté. The serum can be used during the day (also under makeup) and at night.
The serum is especially recommended for dry skin or skin irritated by cosmetic treatments, but can be used by people with all skin types.
The serum can be used daily, morning and evening, depending on the individual needs of the skin.
Yes, the serum with bioferments can be used under makeup because it absorbs well and does not leave a greasy layer.
Using serums with bioferments during pregnancy is usually safe, but it is worth consulting your doctor before starting any new cosmetic treatment during pregnancy.
